pairs.subject: time-travel-replay
pairs.evidence: src/hooks/execution/useReplayTimeline.ts:265 apportions lines evenly when the log has no recorded tempo, and the per-line `recorded` flag (useReplayTimeline.ts:22) is read by nothing outside the hook, so lines animate in at invented moments with no per-element estimate mark and the readout (TimelineScrubber.tsx:193) prints exact time over reconstructed ground

techniques.evidence: src/hooks/execution/useReplayTimeline.ts:22 `recorded` is computed per line but never rendered (no consumer outside the hook); TimelineScrubber.tsx:193 formatMs prints 1.2s/ms precision regardless of tempo provenance, and the replay has no provenance summary before play

src/hooks/execution/useReplayTimeline.ts:265 no-tempo fallback spaces lines proportionally over totalMs - the 'proportional-looking spacing over apportioned timestamps' the standard refuses; gaps with recorded tempo are disclosed (TimelineScrubber.tsx:138)
src/hooks/execution/useReplayTimeline.ts:494 skip-silence is a toggle-style control gated on recorded tempo and confined to the silence the playhead is inside
src/features/agents/sub_executions/replay/ReplayCostPanel.tsx:46 cost re-accrues with position (useReplayTimeline.ts:413) and is prefixed ~ as an estimate against the real total
